crime: Over several evenings, one girl practiced pool in the recreation room while {WITCH_NAME} kept score and returned balls across the table. Each night, the player asked her to come back the next evening.

Then one night, the player handed her the chalk and asked her to pass it to the girl who usually kept score. {WITCH_NAME} said she was the regular scorekeeper. The player finally looked up and admitted that she had never studied her face closely enough to recognize it.

Later that evening, prisoners found the player dead behind the pool table, with deep sword wounds in her chest. A sword was missing from the lounge, and at first it seemed that the weapon had been removed from the rooms used by the prisoners.

A girl who had crossed the entrance hall during the interval remembered seeing her descend the great stairs with what looked like an extra wooden handle for the cleaning tools. {WITCH_NAME} placed it among the other tools. The witness had not touched it. When another prisoner did, the false appearance vanished. The handle was the missing lounge sword, still stained with the dead girl's blood.

One of the dead girl's hands was pinned beneath her body, still clutching a clump of hair torn out at the roots. It matched a fresh, uneven gap in {WITCH_NAME}'s hair. She claimed that she had only found the body and hidden the sword in panic, but the trapped hair showed that the dead girl had grabbed her during a close struggle. The witness's account also placed the bloodied sword in her hands. She had disguised the lounge sword as a cleaning handle before carrying it upstairs. Its shape, weight, and texture never changed, and the victim's first contact with the blade broke the guise. She stabbed the girl, gave the sword the same false appearance again, and carried it down to the entrance-hall tools.
fields.epitaph: At last she could not leave their sight, and still no gaze met hers.
execution: A clear glass display case encloses her alone. Its transparent walls move inward together, pinning her arms and torso before pressing into her shoulders, sides, chest, and back. They keep closing until her ribs and chest are crushed. The walls stop only when the case is shut around her lifeless body, leaving her crushed and fully visible inside.

magic.name: Common Guise
magic.text: By touching anything, she can make it look like any ordinary object she chooses.
